about: The numbers behind docs/ops/engine-cutover-timetable.md. Every value with an enforcing source is pinned to that source by tests/the-cutover-timetable-matches-the-gates.law.test.ts; change the gate and this file together, then run node scripts/ops/engine-cutover-timetable.mjs --write.

conventions.rule: No Horse switch or settings write from selection (slot -30 min) until the Cutover lane posts SEALED.
conventions.source: Cutover lane posts in COORDINATION-INBOX.md (holds and 'HOLDS LIFTED' per cycle)
conventions.enforcement: Partial: scripts/ops/horse-option-switch-lib.mjs reads the inbox text for BOOKING / SEALED and the engine /health maintenance phase, but no clock rule refuses a write at slot -30.
conventions.gap: Encode slot -30 min .. SEALED as a clock hold in checkMaintenanceAndCutoverHold, keyed to the slots above.

conventions.rule: Release-control merges (workflows, selector, standby, seal scripts) land only in the post-seal slot: after SEALED and before slot +50 min, one per slot, merged by the Cutover lane.
conventions.source: Cutover lane posts (for example 2026-11-24T16:02:16Z: 'release-control slot open until 16:50Z')
conventions.gap: A merge gate that refuses a CONTROL_INPUTS change outside [SEALED, slot +50 min).

conventions.source: Derived from the applier's minute refusal (apply-recorded-migration.mjs) and the dispatcher's FIRST_ADMITTED_MINUTE / WINDOW_OPENS_MINUTE
conventions.enforcement: Indirect: a merge at any minute is accepted; the dispatcher then waits (bounded) for the next admitted minute. Nothing refuses the merge itself.
conventions.gap: None needed for correctness (the dispatcher waits); documented so lanes know when an install actually happens.

conventions.rule: An engine change that must ship in a slot merges early enough for a Backup certificate before selection (a certificate takes about 45-55 minutes).
conventions.source: backup-engine.yml header ('a certificate takes about forty-five minutes') and Cutover lane posts
conventions.enforcement: Selection binds protected main at slot -30 min and takes the newest certified commit; nothing refuses a late merge, it simply ships a slot later.
conventions.gap: Publish the cycle's readiness at slot -75 and slot -45 (Cutover lane item C).

conventions.rule: World Hub and hand sessions keep migrations out of [slot -90 min, slot +10 min) as Club Arena's dispatcher does.
conventions.enforcement: Only the nightly release schema freeze (23:45-04:15) is refused in the database for every repo (#11906). The daytime cycle deferral is enforced only by Club Arena's dispatcher; O23 (#11910) makes the selector ignore migrations Club Arena never shipped.
conventions.gap: Extend smarter_private.fn_ca_release_freeze_refuses_migrations to the daytime cycle deferral window.

pendingChanges: Cutover lane item A: the post-seal Backup certifies main's newest unshipped candidate on a copy taken after the post-seal install window.
Cutover lane item B: ordinary migrations install only from slot +10 to slot +30 min (today they install from slot +10 min until slot +90 min, when the next slot's hold begins).
